label: Four oak trees, read as four years but not confirmed
description: He sees four oak trees and thinks it means four years, while warning against assuming his own interpretation, since the full meaning can take months or years to arrive.

label: Yankees and Dodgers in the World Series, with attacks on Yankee Stadium
description: Seen in May 2024: the New York Yankees and the Los Angeles Dodgers going to the World Series, and attempted attacks on Yankee Stadium given as a standing prayer assignment.

label: He is told Super Bowl winners in advance but keeps them private
description: He says the Lord tells him well ahead of time who will win the Super Bowl, and that he writes it down and keeps it inside the family.
aliases: who's going to win the super bowl

label: A red wave over America in November 2024
description: Red spreading over all of America as a red wave, claimed to have been given in November 2023, with Chicago alone keeping Illinois from turning.

label: A million-person daily prayer army by 2025
description: A stated goal of a million people praying daily with the channel for the nations by 2025.

label: No major virus and no dollar takedown through 2028
description: Declared in prayer: no virus or plague through 2025 to 2028, and no remaining plan to take down the dollar because it has been averted.

label: Isaacs are coming in every area, not just babies
description: Promised increase, new jobs, multiplication and promotions alongside the babies, described as Isaacs.

label: A great house of cards comes down
description: A great house of cards seen falling, with the timing unknown and explicitly prayed away from 2025.

label: Words of knowledge naming conditions in the audience
description: Specific ailments named mid-prayer as present among viewers: swollen feet and ankles, gout, prostate and testosterone trouble, with healing commanded.

label: No doom and gloom for the body of Christ
description: Whatever comes on the world, there is no doom and gloom for the church, which wins regardless.
